claims.text: A 60-second apnea window from recording a01, starting at 2000-01-01T07:20:00+00:00 and ending at 07:21:00+00:00, was flagged as an anomaly.

The detector classified the window as anomaly with a reconstruction error of 0.3352, exceeding the anomaly threshold of 0.0453 by a normalized margin of 6.40; this is reconstruction threshold evidence, not a probability or calibrated confidence.

The model is a BiLSTM temporal-attention autoencoder (version apnea-01-a01_seed2026) trained on the apnea dataset with test patient a01; no signal-level or attention-level evidence was available for this window.
The current event is supported by detector evidence showing a clear anomaly margin, but signal and attention explanations are unavailable, and no longitudinal or clinical context was supplied.
